L_cov · from the §2 identity · T²/(C·P) − 2T/C + 1
Decompose before you call it rank. At ep 67 L_cov 6.26 → 3.58. Holding rank at the control's 101.8 and moving trace alone already gets 4.43, so 68% of the drop is trace and 32% is rank — against the 26.5% trace share §2 predicted. ZTotalVar runs 505–540 here against 590–640 for the control, i.e. the penalty banked the cheap scale win first. It is not the scale-only null: rank is higher at every epoch. But ΔL_cov overstates the rank effect ~2×.

Findings — in the order of the falsifiers

Falsifier 1, in direction but not in magnitude. Keep the term; do not believe the rank story.

1
Rank rose and recon followed — but not past 150. ZPartRank 101.8 → 120.2 at ep 67 with LossRecon_Comp −8.9% / −8.5%. The term is cheap and it works, so it becomes the default third loss. The ceiling it buys is ~121/512, not the ~300 an L_cov → 1.0 implies. The estimator was part of the ceiling, not all of it.
2
A new best on the weight axis, narrowly. It clears the 0.01 arm at 0.0511 / 0.0367 against 0.0528 / 0.0370 — but the nuScenes margin is 0.8%, inside the 6% weight plateau. KITTI's 3.2% carries the claim. The separation comes from a higher dose at the same base: land materially below 0.0528 / 0.0370 and "cov only moves you along the weight axis" dies, because no sigreg_weight ever reached there.
3
The scale-only null is excluded, but it is closer than predicted. 68% of the ep-67 L_cov drop is trace, not 26.5%. Rank moved at every epoch, so the null does not hold — quote the decomposition, never ΔL_cov.
4
The decoded win does not reach ground truth. Round-trip PredVsOrig improves 3–18%, but against GT it is ≤2.2% on KITTI and slightly negative on nuScenes (+0.4 to +1.4%). The frozen teacher's own error is 2.53 / 3.22 / 1.14 on nuScenes against a 0.35 / 0.48 / 0.24 round-trip, so the tokenizer is 7–13% of what a user sees there. Token-space wins at tc512 are near the point of not mattering downstream.
5
nuScenes raymap is the one consistent regression. +1.0% TF, +5.0% AR, +1.4% vs GT. Isotropy pressure appears to cost the rotational part of the code on the multi-camera set. Worth one look before this goes on by default.
Next — queued. A cov_weight dose-response at the same base: BSC:45498520 (1e-4) and BSC:45498521 (3e-4), 44 h each, from scratch. This arm is at its equilibrium, not out of wall time: at ep 72 trace is 540.7 against the 512 target with rank flat at 121.1, and the T=512 floor of L_cov is 3.26 against its actual 3.58 — only 9% of what remains is trace. More weight moves it; more epochs will not. ZPartRank survives as a target provisionally — rank and recon moved together at matched epochs and matched compute, which is one A/B, not a causal proof.
